title: Linear-output cubic reservoir and stronger uniform family

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"H_N=family.evaluate on all N actual bits, with LINEAR-output trace-cubic reservoir, group exponent1-beta/2, slice exponentbeta/2-1/2000000 and minimum-source-certificate selection over guarded plans. Uniform P program family.py; empty-witness NP verifier proof.md. Ties first; fallback output0 and t_N=u_N=d_plan=N+1.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"The self-contained trilinear moment/dense-rank proof gives every biased Boolean cubic a constant affine subspace of codimension<=128ceil(log2(2/delta)); whenever its displayed finite guards pass, the trace-cubic primitive outputs floor(w/10000) bits at affine entropy w of2w with error<=2*2^(-w/2000). For each fully guarded accepted candidate p, define original geometry dimension d(p)=1+C(Q-1), actual same-map primitive entropies Theta_j,Hsrc_j and scalar recurrence (SEL1). source_certificate computes u(p)=min(d(p),c_H+1+(S-1)(C-1)) with S=Dtot+max(Y_s0,max_j Theta_j+1)+3. The controller selects least u(p). At its selected plan t_N is the exact POS/DP threshold and d_plan=d(p); t_N<=u_N<=d_plan. These values are uniformly polynomial-time computable from N. C_B2(H_N)>=4N-8t_N+8>=4N-8u_N+8 holds for EVERY integer N>=0. At EVERY sufficiently large integer length u_N<=2^ceil(D_lin Z), D_lin=425007/100000=4.25007, Z=ceil(L^(3/4))*ceil(B^(1/4)), L=ceil(log2 N), B=ceil(log2(L+1)). Also limsup log2(u_N)/Z<=CstarLin<=1062517/250000, CstarLin=inf_(Slin)(w0+X) for the new Slin defined in proof.md. For each fixed real epsilon>0, C_B2(H_N)>=4N-N^epsilon at ALL sufficiently large integer lengths, and this SAME new fixed family has liminf C_B2(H_N)/N>=4. The new family uses changed cubic/grouping maps and need not equal preceding families.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
